_meta.description: Line 5's stations in order from Kapurbawdi: the 17 station points in MMRDA's alignment file (uploaded March 2025), plus Kongaon West, which the revised plan adds without a published position. Positions come from that file (scripts/build-alignment-line5.py). 'phase' follows the site's naming: 1 Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, 2 to Kongaon West, 3 Durgadi to Kalyan. 'revised_plan_2026' says what MMRDA's press release of 28 May 2026 does with each station; Phase 3's new stations (Khadakpada, Bhoirwadi and others) have no published positions and are not listed yet. 'eia_chainage_m' is the station's chainage in MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023); those chainages do not match the distances between the station points in the alignment file (for example Kalher to Purna: 0.83 km in the report, about 2 km apart on the map) and are kept as published. 'same_site_as' names a station of another line at the same place, with the distance between the two points.
